A '''diamond sword''' is a [[Weapons#Sword|sword]] of the [[Diamond equipment|diamond]] tier, crafted from two [[diamond]]s and a stick. It is the base for the [[Electrum Sword|electrum sword]], [[adamant sword]] and [[adamant claymore]].

=== Loot ===

== Usage ==

=== Combat ===
It deals {{Value|Diamond Sword|damage}} damage at an attack speed of {{Value|Diamond Sword|attackspeed}} and has {{Value|Diamond Sword|durability}} durability, the strongest sword without an alloy.

=== Repairing ===
It can be repaired in an [[anvil]] with [[diamond]]s. The pack resets repair costs to zero, so it can be repaired indefinitely; see [[Repairing]].

=== Smelting and smithing ===
{{Uses}}

In a [[blast furnace]] it melts down into one diamond. It is the base for both [[Electrum equipment|electrum]] and [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] upgrades.
